title: How long does custom software development take? Realistic timelines

points.heading: Realistic timelines by project type
points.body: Notice that none of these say "one week" and none say "two years".

points.heading: What actually determines the timeline
points.body: People assume the timeline is about how fast a developer types.

points.heading: Where the time actually goes
points.body: A typical 10-week project doesn't mean 10 weeks of writing code.

cta.headline: The full piece is on the site.
cta.sub: From a 3-week API integration to a 6-month platform: realistic timelines for custom software, what stretches them, and how to keep yours short.
